_meta.feast: The Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John
_meta._note: OCA does not publish a Matins DOCX for this feast. Matins from St-Sergius Emenaion (yy/archaic register). Two canons both in Tone IV: Canon I by John the Monk (8 troparia); Canon II by Andrew of Crete (6 troparia). Magnificat retained.

troparion.text:
O prophet and forerunner of the coming of Christ,
we who honor thee with love are at a loss how to worthily praise thee;
for by thy glorious and honored nativity
thou didst loose the barrenness of her who gave birth to thee
and the muteness of thy father,//
and proclaimed to the world the incarnation of the Son of God.
troparion.label: Troparion of the holy forerunner

kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy forerunner

sedalion.text:
Now the fruit of Zacharias, the adornment of the desert, the foundation of the prophets, hath sprung forth,
bringing gladness noetically to the thoughts of the faithful;
wherefore, the forerunner of Christ hath appeared, the true witness of His coming.
With spiritual songs let us together cry out to the Baptist:
O prophet and preacher of the truth, pray thou that we be saved!
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 1)

bothNow.text:
As he contemplated that which was beyond nature
Joseph was struck with wonder O Theotokos, at thy conception without seed.
He contemplated the mysterious dew upon the fleece,
the bush un-burnt by fire,
Aaron's rod which budded.
Thus thy Betrothed and guardian bore witness and cried unto the priests saying:
A Virgin beareth a child,//
and after child-birth remaineth yet a virgin.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

sedalion.text:
O all-praised John, thou wast truly and most gloriously born as the herald of the coming of Christ,
the chief of the prophets;
and, as the voice of the Word, thou didst cry out:
"Repent! The kingdom of heaven is at hand!"
Wherefore, having prepared the way of the Lord,
thou wast shown to the ends of the earth as the forerunner of grace.
O baptizer and apostle, entreat Christ God,
that He grant forgiveness of transgressions unto those who celebrate thy holy memory with love.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 2)

bothNow.text:
O most holy Virgin, Mother of Christ, heal thou the cruel passions of my soul, I pray,
and grant me forgiveness of my transgressions,
which I have foolishly committed, defiling both soul and body, wretch that I am.
Woe is me! What shall I do at that hour
when the angels will separate my soul from my passion-plagued body?
Then be thou my helper and most fervent intercessor,
for I, thy servant, have thee as my hope.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

magnification.refrain:
We magnify thee, O John, forerunner of the Savior,
and we honor thy most glorious birth from a barren woman.
verses: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for He hath visited and wrought deliverance for His people.
Glory… Both now… Alleluia… Glory to thee, O God!

sessionalHymns.text:
Let the father rejoice. Be glad, O mother,
for today thou hast given birth on earth unto a prophet,
the forerunner summoned by God by the promise.
The barren woman nurtureth the Baptist as a babe,
and Zacharias rejoiceth, saying to the infant:
"My tongue hath been loosed by thine advent on earth, O candle-stand of the Light!
A miracle truly most glorious!"
sessionalHymns.label: Sessional Hymn after the Polyeleios

bothNow.text:
We ever thank thee, O pure Theotokos who art full of grace,
and we magnify and bow down before thee,
hymning thy birthgiving and crying out without ceasing:
Save us, O almighty Virgin, in that thou art good,
and rescue us from the dread sentence of the demons at the hour of trial,
that we, thy servants, may not be put to shame.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

prokeimenon.refrain:
And thou, O child,
shalt be called the prophet of the Most High.
prokeimenon.verse: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, for He hath visited and wrought deliverance for His people.

gospel._note: Elizabeth's conception and the birth of John; Zacharias' tongue loosed.

postGospelSticheron.text:
He who was sanctified from his mother's womb
and was the fulfillment of the prophecy,
is born today of a barren woman,
manifestly proclaiming the coming of the Lord, saying://
"Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!"
postGospelSticheron.label: Sticheron after Psalm 50

_authors.first: John the Monk (Canon I, Tone IV, 8 troparia)
_authors.second: Andrew of Crete (Canon II, Tone IV, 6 troparia)

canon._canonNote: Two canons both in Tone IV. Katavasiae: 'I shall open my mouth' (the Theotokos canon irmoi).

ode1.irmos:
O Thou who wast born of the Virgin,
drown I implore Thee, in the depth of dispassion
the triune nature of my soul,
as Thou didst the mighty strongholds of the warriors,
that in the mortality of my flesh as on a timbrel
I may chant a hymn of victory.
ode1.irmos2:
Let us chant unto God our Redeemer,
Who of old guided Israel fleeing from the slavery of Pharaoh,
and fed them in the wilderness,
for He hath been glorified.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The offspring of the barren woman manifestly proclaimeth the birthgiving of the Virgin,
preceding the Sun like a magnificent dawn.
And he now shineth forth the light of piety and grace upon the whole universe.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O most immaculate Theotokos, thou godly city of the King of all,
habitation well-pleasing unto God, precious treasure:
preserve thine inheritance, which ever praiseth thee and honoreth thy birthgiving with faith.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
While the priest was censing in the temple, an angel from on high stood before him and cried aloud:
"I am come unto thee bearing news of a strange birthgiving, O elder!
For thou shalt receive from the barren woman the baptizer of Christ as your offspring."

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
"Wherefore dost thou marvel, O elder?
Why standest thou, refusing to believe the one who telleth thee these things?
For he is an angel, even if he is in the semblance of a man,
be thou therefore mute until the time of the birth of the voice of the Word!"

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
He who made the silence of Zacharias a symbol of the written law
hath thereby shown me to be a preacher of repentance who cry out:
He giveth unto the barren woman a son who is the voice who crieth.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O the most glorious pronouncements of the Forerunner of Christ!
He who, even before he was wrapped in swaddling bands,
recognized Him who hath loosed our bonds and sanctified the nations,
is born today of Elizabeth and looseth the voice of his father.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Thou art the habitation of God and the noetic ladder by which God hath descended
and, taking our form, hath led our nature up to the heavens.
Thee do we all praise as the mediatress of our salvation.

ode3.irmos:
Not in wisdom, nor in power do we glory,
but we glory in Thee O Christ,
the Hypostatic Wisdom of the Father,
for there is none more holy than Thee, O Lover of mankind.
ode3.irmos2:
Having established the thunder and fashioned the wind:
do Thou make me steadfast O Lord,
that I may hymn Thee in truth and do Thy will;
for none is as holy as Thou, O our God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The elderly and barren woman kisseth the Virgin Mother, truly recognizing her birthgiving,
for the bond of her barrenness hath been loosed by the will of God.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Elizabeth, who before was barren, prefigured Thy Church of the nations, O Christ,
and, giving birth most gloriously, she hath revealed as most fertile that which once was seen to be barren.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Making straight the ways of the Lord and preparing His path, O prophet and herald of Christ,
thou didst show mankind the fruits of repentance, teaching them the way of life.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Dancing today, Elizabeth holdeth thee in her elderly arms, O Forerunner, and crieth out, uttering the praise:
None is as holy as Thou, O Lord our God!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O most holy Theotokos, thou didst loose the grief of our first parents,
giving birth to the Creator of life and Redeemer for us.
Him do thou earnestly entreat, that thy flock be saved.

sedalenAfterOde3.text:
The Forerunner, the voice of the Word, upon his birth splendidly loosed the voice of Zacharias,
and he hath shown unto all the barrenness of the law, crying out:
Repent, ye who are on earth, for, lo! Jesus cometh and hath appeared,
desiring to deliver all from the primal curse, illumining them with baptism!
Truly this is a most glorious wonder!
sedalenAfterOde3.label: Sessional Hymn (after Ode 3)

glory.text:
Like the radiant sun, the son of Zacharias hath shone forth upon us through the womb of Elizabeth,
and loosed the muteness of his father,
crying out to all men with great boldness:
"Make straight the way of the Lord! For He freeth and saveth those who have recourse unto Him."
Entreat Him Whom didst thou preach, O John, that our souls be saved.

bothNow.text:
By thy divine birthgiving, O pure one,
thou hast renewed the mortal nature of those born on earth,
which had become corrupt through the passions,
raising up all from death to a life of incorruption.
Wherefore, as is meet we all bless thee,//
O exceedingly glorious Virgin, as thou didst foretell.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

ode4.irmos:
He who sitteth in glory upon the throne of the Godhead,
Jesus the true God,
is come in a swift cloud
and with His sinless hands he hath saved those who cry:
Glory to Thy power, O Christ.
ode4.irmos2:
I have heard of Thy glorious Dispensation, O Christ our God:
how Thou wast born of the Virgin,
that Thou mightest deliver from error those who cry aloud to Thee:
Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
A mystery hath preceded ineffable mysteries,
proclaiming release from suffering by a renewed nature,
through its correction and deification, O Christ.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Isaiah prophesied that when the Son would become flesh,
the Father would say:
"Behold, I send before Thy face an earthly angel, the equal of the angels,
who crieth out: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!"

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: The womb of the holy Theotokos, in whom it was Thy good pleasure
to make Thine abode as in a fragrant dwelling, O supremely divine Word of the Father,
was neither corrupted, nor suffered pain;
for she gaveth birth to Emmanuel: God and man.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Virginity is established and chastity doth triumph;
the desert rejoiceth, and the world holdeth festival in thy nativity, O Forerunner!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Elizabeth rejoiceth and Zacharias speaketh once again.
Both, therefore, become young in their old age
and are rendered luminous through John the voice of the Word.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Of old, the lawgiver saw thee as the bush unconsumed by the fire,
and Daniel envisioned thee as a holy mountain,
O Sovereign Lady who alone art Mother and Virgin.

ode5.irmos:
Now I shall arise said God prophetically,
now I shall be glorified, now I shall be exalted,
elevating fallen human nature, which I received from the Virgin,
to the noetic light of My divinity.
ode5.irmos2:
Shine upon me, O Lord, the light of Thy commandments,
for my soul riseth early to Thee and hymneth Thee:
For Thou art our God,
and unto Thee do I flee, O King of peace.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The earth hath given rise to the true herald, the voice who preacheth to all,
with the tongue of the Spirit, the Son of the Virgin,
righteousness from heaven which hath come down to us in a bodily substance.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The Lord hath appointed thee the true luminary of Christ, enlightening all,
clothing only those who are His enemies in shame, as in a garment,
and forthrightly proclaiming the Word and Son of God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: He Who is begotten of the Father hath been born of thee and is ever with thee:
the ever-existing and indivisible Word, the only-begotten Son,
Who, in the latter days, became incarnate of the Virgin and the Holy Spirit.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O Sun of righteousness, Thou hast prepared a star, Thy baptizer John,
who today is born according to Thy promise and hath loosed the voice of his father.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O prophet, herald and forerunner, offspring of the barren woman, preacher of repentance,
lamb of the wilderness, and lampstand of the Light:
pray thou for all with faith who honor thee.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: We hymn thee, O Sovereign Lady, Mother of the Creator of all,
as the impassable portal, the bush unconsumed,
and the unquarried mountain from whom was cut the Stone Who is He Who assumed flesh from thee.

ode6.irmos:
I have reached the depths of the sea
and the tempest of my many sins hath engulfed me;
but do Thou raise up my life from the abyss
O Greatly-merciful One.
ode6.irmos2:
The tempest of evil thoughts, hath overwhelmed me,
dragging me down into the abyss of my numberless sins;
but, going before me, O good Helmsman,
govern me as Thou didst the Prophet, and save me.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
While yet in thy mother's womb, as a prophet thou didst recognize the Word of God,
and, deified by the unapproachable light,
thou didst utter theology in that dark chamber, employing her tongue.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As the voice of one crying unceasingly, O Baptist,
cease thou never to entreat the Redeemer of the world,
that He loose the spiritual barrenness of those who hymn thy nativity.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Thy womb, O pure Theotokos, was revealed to be the dwelling-place of the unapproachable Godhead,
upon Whom the heavenly ranks cannot gaze without fear.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Today John is born: the citizen of the desert, the preacher of repentance,
the true witness of grace, the forerunner of the Word, the star which shineth before the Light.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Today, the axe which hath been forged, hath portended the hewing of barren souls,
and planting the fruits of the virtues, hath surely come forth in thy nativity, O forerunner.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Coming forth, the candle-stand of the Light preached the coming of the Savior,
the Lamb of God, Who hath shone forth light upon the earth,
offered spiritually for all nature.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O all-immaculate Birthgiver of God, who hast given birth to the Abyss of mercy:
drowning the abyss of my passions in the depths of thy compassions,
grant me a torrent of tears from my soul.

kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy forerunner

ode7.irmos:
The three youths in Babylon, regarded the tyrant's command as foolishness,
and cried aloud in the midst of the flame:
Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!
ode7.irmos2:
In the Persian furnace the youths and descendants of Abraham,
burning with a love of piety rather than by a flame of fire,
cried aloud saying:
Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thy nativity through the barren woman hath healed all afflicted nature, O forerunner,
teaching it to chant: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The most honored Elizabeth, that barren and childless woman, is like unto the Church:
which before was bedimmed with sacrifices and ordure now boasteth in beauty and birthgiving.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
We honor thee, O John, as the mediator between the old and the new testaments,
the one who maketh straight the paths of Christ
Who cleanseth the threshing-floor of transgression with the winnowing-fan of the Spirit.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
We all hymn the glorious John who issued forth from the barren woman,
the forerunner and preacher of repentance,
who hastened like a star before the Sun, Christ our God.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Virgin Theotokos, cease thou never to pray on behalf of all unto Him
Who, without seed, made His abode within thy womb,
Who, in His ineffable and utter humility, was born and beggared Himself for our sake.

ode8.irmos:
O almighty Redeemer of all,
having descended and bedewed the children in the midst of the flame,
Thou didst teach them to sing:
All ye works bless and hymn the Lord.
ode8.irmos2:
In wisdom hast Thou fashioned all things, O Master,
Thou didst establish the earth firmly upon the fathomless depths of the waters,
in accordance with Thy knowledge,
wherefore we hymn Thee chanting:
Unceasingly bless ye the Lord all ye works of the Lord.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
A turtle-dove hath issued forth from the womb of the barren one!
Like a divinely planted grove she hath offered the forerunner of Christ unto the Church, chanting:
All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
O God-bearing people, holy nation, liken yourselves unto the turtle-dove of Christ
and, abiding in chastity, chant ye with voices flowing with honey:
All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord!

troparia.refrain: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
troparia.text:
Triadicon: Illumined with the threefold Light, let us worship the one uncreated Godhead,
ceaselessly crying aloud in an Orthodox manner:
All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Before thy birth, before thine own swaddling-clothes, O forerunner,
thou didst recognize Christ, the Bestower of life,
Whom thou didst worship, pointing Him out by leaping,
and naming Him thy Lord, by borrowing thy mother's tongue, and singing unto Christ our God.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Today the Jordan, likening itself to John, hath leapt up most gloriously in its fluid torrents,
listening to him whose life is like unto that of the angels,
who was born of a barren and elderly woman,
who maketh straight the ways and paths of the Lord and hath baptized the world.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Today Zacharias noted on a slate the name of the prophet and forerunner which was designated by God,
and in his silence he declared:
Let him be called John who is born to me in mine old age!
This marvelous designation befitteth one who was begotten according to God's promise.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Thy people, O Virgin, have thee as a mighty consolation, a hope unashamed,
an unassailable rampart and divine intercession,
and, saved, they glorify and cry out to thee earnestly:
Bless the Lord unceasingly, all ye works of the Lord!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Lo! the voice of the forerunner falleth upon barren and empty hearts, crying:
Prepare ye now the way of Christ, for He shall come in glory,
and, submitting ourselves, we magnify Him!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As of old, O forerunner, thou didst through the Holy Spirit manifestly preach the Son,
Who is the Lamb of God Who taketh away the sins of the world,
ask thou forgiveness of sins for thy flock.

troparia.refrain: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
troparia.text:
Triadicon: Chanting in an Orthodox manner, O ye faithful, let us glorify the threefold Unity,
the consubstantial Trinity, Who illumineth us divinely
and filleth our souls with the splendors of the never-waning light.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O thou who hast dominion over all creatures,
grant the trophy of victory to thy people
and set the feet of Orthodox hierarchs upon all heresies and schisms,
that we may magnify thee as the Theotokos.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Behold, in thee, O priest, hath God wrought a great and most glorious sign;
for thou hast begotten a son, the forerunner, in thine old age and in the mortality of thy flesh.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Let barren women hearken and chant unto God!
For, lo! Elizabeth crieth out:
I give birth unto a son of mine old age and in the mortality of my flesh!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Be glad and rejoice now in God, O Zacharias!
For, lo! Elizabeth nourisheth the son of her old age at her breast
and in the mortality of her flesh giveth birth to the forerunner.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Glory to Him Who hath giveth fruit to the barren woman in her old age
and hath bestowed upon the aged prophet a son, the divine forerunner,
who prepareth for Him a perfected people.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: He Who was begotten in the bosom of the Father without passion and corruption,
having made His abode within thee, in His loving-kindness
hath led us to the Father and the divine Spirit.

exapostilaria.text:
Today the joyous birth of the forerunner looseth the grief of his father's muteness
and the barrenness of her who bore him.
And he declareth the present joy and gladness.
Wherefore, all creation doth celebrate it with splendor.
exapostilaria.label: Exaposteilarion of the holy forerunner

exapostilaria.text:
The prophets preached, the apostles taught,
and with godly wisdom the martyrs openly confessed thy Son to be the God of all, O most pure one.
With them we glorify thee, delivered by thee from the ancient sentence.
exapostilaria.label: Theotokion (at Glory ... Both now)

stichera.verse: To do among them the judgment that is written: this glory shall be to all His saints. (Ps. 149:9)
stichera.text:
O most glorious wonder!
From a mother advanced in age
hath John, the proclaimer of God the Word
hastened to issue forth today,
and by his nativity he most clearly revealeth the bound tongue to speak.
O Thine ineffable dispensation, O Master,
whereby, O Christ,//
save Thou our souls, in that Thou alone art merciful.

stichera.verse: Praise God in His saints; praise Him in the firmament of His power. (Ps. 150:1)
stichera.text:
O most glorious wonder!
The prophet who is the greatest among those born of women
looseth the condemnation of his mother's barrenness,
coming with the spirit and power of Elijah to make straight the way of the Lord.
O Thine ineffable tender compassion, O Master,
whereby, O Christ,//
save Thou our souls, in that Thou alone art merciful.

stichera.verse: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His exceeding greatness. (Ps. 150:2)
stichera.text:
O most glorious wonder!
He Who preached to men the condescension of Christ
with his voice doth indicate Him Who transcendeth all,
and with power divine looseth the barrenness of her who gave him birth
and the tongue of Zacharias.
O Thy great wonders, O Master!
Thereby, O Christ,//
do Thou save those who honor Thy great forerunner.

stichera.verse: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the psaltery and harp. (Ps. 150:3)
stichera.text:
O most glorious wonder!
The prophet and forerunner is shown to be the greatest born of women,
and the most sublime prophet and herald of the coming of Christ,
leaping up in his mother's womb.
O Thine exceeding great gifts, O Lover of mankind!
Thereby, O Christ,//
save Thou our souls, in that Thou art almighty.

doxastikon.text:
The forerunner, the star of stars, John who longeth for God,
is born on earth today from a barren womb,
and he revealeth the radiance of Christ, the Orient from on high,//
for the straight passage of the faithful.
doxastikon.author: by Anatolius

theotokion.text:
O Theotokos, thou art the true vine
that hast budded forth for us the Fruit of life.
Thee do we entreat:
Pray thou, O Lady, with the holy apostles,//
that He have mercy upon our souls.
theotokion.label: Theotokion at Both now

troparionAfterDoxology.text:
O prophet and forerunner of the coming of Christ,
we who honor thee with love are at a loss how to worthily praise thee;
for by thy glorious and honored nativity
thou didst loose the barrenness of her who gave birth to thee
and the muteness of thy father,//
and proclaimed to the world the incarnation of the Son of God.
